explanation about payment_gate:

What is payment_gate?
It’s a parameter that tells PayWay which type of response/flow you want when your merchant has multiple services (e.g. Checkout vs QR).

When to use it?
Use it when you want to force Ecommerce Checkout (hosted HTML/redirect URL) instead of QR JSON.

How to use it?
In your /payments/purchase request, add:
"payment_gate": "0"
This tells PayWay: "Return the normal Ecommerce Checkout page/URL".

If you don’t send payment_gate, and your merchant is also enabled for QR services, the API may return QR-style JSON instead.

You can keep your payment_option (e.g. abapay_khqr) as needed; payment_gate = "0" just forces the checkout HTML behavior.
